name: Pukaskwa National Park
policyReason: Pets are allowed on a leash under 3 m.
summary: Pets are allowed on a leash under 3 m.

excerpts.quote: Pets must be kept on a leash of less than three metres, at all times, for their own protection and for the protection of others.

dogRules.text: Leash under 3 m at all times.
Pets are welcome at the oTENTik site, leashed and never unattended.
Some areas are closed to pets; check notices at trailheads.
